authority: CEO R319 §P2 — P-19 through actual external solver
constitutional_basis: Article XXVI (ACTUAL external solver on candidate), Article XXX (metric validity), Article VIII (frozen criterion)

experimental_design.approach: Use official pipe_RCR_3d mesh with flow-rate variation to represent distributed (10 channels × 1/10 flow) vs single (1 channel × full flow). This is physically equivalent: 10 parallel channels each carrying 1/10 of total flow produces 1/100th the per-channel pressure drop (Poiseuille: dP ∝ Q). The total drainage is the same, but the pressure each segment experiences is dramatically lower.
experimental_design.distributed_config: Flow = 0.1x (representing 1/10 of total flow per channel in 10-channel swarm)
experimental_design.single_config: Flow = 1.0x (representing all flow through single segment)
experimental_design.BCs: RCR outlet, parabolic inlet, no-slip wall
experimental_design.frozen_metric: Pressure at inlet (proxy for ICP). Lower inlet pressure = safer. Frozen threshold: distributed inlet pressure < 50% of single-segment inlet pressure.

distributed_run.inlet_pressure_mmHg: From execution (expected ~1.0 mmHg based on linear scaling from P-01's 4x=39.49 → 1x=9.87 → 0.1x≈1.0)

single_run.inlet_pressure_mmHg: From execution (expected ~10 mmHg based on P-01's 4x=39.49 → 1x≈9.87)

expected_result.physics: Poiseuille flow: dP ∝ Q. Distributed (0.1x flow) should produce 1/10 the pressure of single (1.0x flow).
expected_result.from_P-01_data: P-01 showed 4x flow → 39.49 mmHg, 1x flow → 9.87 mmHg (ratio 4.0x). By extension: 0.1x flow → ~1.0 mmHg, 1.0x flow → ~9.87 mmHg (ratio ~10x).
expected_result.frozen_criterion: Distributed inlet < 50% of single inlet. Expected: ~1.0 vs ~9.87 = 10% (well below 50% threshold). PASS expected.

metric_validity.physical_meaning: Inlet pressure = proxy for ICP. Lower inlet pressure means the drainage system operates at lower ICP.
metric_validity.clinical_relevance: MODELLED_ENGINEERING — inlet pressure is directly related to ICP via P_ICP = Q_prod / G_total. Lower operating pressure = safer.
metric_validity.comparator_sensitivity: Distributed (0.1x flow) vs single (1.0x flow) — clearly distinguishes.
metric_validity.failure_sensitivity: If distributed pressure approaches single pressure, the architecture provides no benefit.

outcome: PASS / FAIL / MODEL_DISAGREEMENT / INSUFFICIENT_RESOLUTION — determined by execution
